queries: AGI achieved declared 2026 consensus artificial general intelligence

sources_considered.why: A blog post on an Nvidia executive's claim that AGI has arrived. It is one disputed claim, not broad recognition, and not a primary source.
A forecasting question. Forecasts are not evidence that AGI arrived.

unresolved_gaps: By 2026-10-28 I found no system broadly accepted as AGI, so neither 'AGI will come' nor 'we will need new ideas' can be tested yet.
Isolated executive claims that AGI has been achieved are disputed and do not reflect broad recognition.
